title: NaviShell plugin registry index
description: The marketplace list NaviShell downloads with the `plugins_fetch_registry` command (Settings > Plugins > Marketplace). The app drops any entry that does not satisfy this schema instead of failing the whole index, so a malformed entry is simply never offered for install. `scripts/check-registry.mjs` validates this file against the schema and the rules the schema cannot express (see registry/README.md).

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion only; the app ignores it.

name.description: Display name of the index itself, shown above the list.

updatedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last change to this file.

plugins.description: The listed plugins. Ids must be unique; duplicates are not rejected by the app, they just both show up.

localizedText.description: Either one string, or an object keyed by UI locale. The app falls back to `en` and then to the first value.

version.description: Dotted numeric version with an optional pre-release suffix, e.g. "1.2.0" or "1.2.0-beta.1".

zipUrl.description: Direct http(s) download URL of a plugin zip (a GitHub Release asset, not a web page). Pin it to a tag, never to a moving branch.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the zip. Strongly recommended: the app verifies it before unpacking and refuses a download that does not match.

category.description: One of the fixed marketplace categories; the app shows them as translated filter chips.

release.description: A previous version of the plugin, kept so the app can offer the newest version a given host supports and users can go back.

version.description: Must be lower than the entry's `version`; releases are listed newest first.

minHostVersion.description: Lowest NaviShell version this release works with.

id.description: The plugin id, identical to `id` in its `plugin.json`. Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only, starting with a letter or digit. The `navishell.` prefix is reserved for built-in plugins. Convention: `<vendor>.<plugin>`.

name.description: Display name shown in the marketplace list.

description.description: One sentence on what the plugin does.

version.description: Version of the plugin the `url` points at, identical to `version` in its `plugin.json`. This is the latest release; older ones go in `releases`.

homepage.description: Documentation page of the plugin (a web page, shown as a link).

readme.description: Raw Markdown README the app renders on the plugin's detail page (e.g. a raw.githubusercontent.com URL pinned to a branch or tag).

changelog.description: Raw Markdown changelog, rendered next to the README.

minHostVersion.description: Lowest NaviShell version the plugin works with, e.g. "0.2.0".

icon.description: A lucide-react icon name in PascalCase, e.g. "Puzzle".

categories.description: Up to three marketplace categories, the first one being the primary.

tags.description: Free-form lowercase keywords for search, e.g. "gpu", "nvidia".

screenshots.description: Image URLs (PNG/JPEG/WebP) shown on the detail page.

releases.description: Previous versions, newest first. The latest version stays in the entry's own `version`/`url`/`sha256` fields so older hosts keep working.
